web_blocks.title: Executive Thesis: Top-Line Turnaround Meets Lease, Dilution & Stage 4 Reality

web_blocks.html: DigitalOcean (NYSE: DOCN) grew Q3 2026 revenue 40% YoY to $321.2M [1]. Total ARR reached $1,285M, and RPO jumped 13x YoY to $799.7M [1][2]. Yet Pass 1 filing forensics show steep costs behind that growth: GAAP gross margin fell 980 bps to 50.15%, finance leases jumped 7x to $923.6M PV ($250M due yearly in 2027–2029), and $2.96B in 11.1-year uncommenced colocation leases sit off balance sheet [1][2]. While demand metrics earned Pass 1's PASS_WITH_WATCH rating, -$986.2M annualized equipment-and-lease cash burn (-$136.0M at 2027 amortization pace), 30% top-51 customer concentration, and discontinued NDR disclosures push KPI health to the brink of FAIL [1][2].

Shareholders also face steep equity dilution and insider selling [2][26]. Basic shares rose +28.2% YTD from 91.95M to 117.92M [2]. Management guided Q4 diluted shares to 128.5M midpoint and filed a $1.0B ATM shelf on November 3 (which would add +14.68M shares to 143.18M at $66.76) [1][26]. Q3 SBC surged +82% YoY to $36.05M, and on November 19 CFO Matt Steinfort filed Form 144 to sell 75,000 shares [2][28].

On November 20, 2026, DOCN dropped -13.40% to $66.76 [23][25]. Basic market cap is $7.88B ($9.09B basic EV; $9.79B diluted EV), trading at 215.56x P/E, 33.82x forward P/E, 8.24x TTM EV/Sales, and 1.22% ROIC [2][25]. Modeling 4.0x Bear compression with +$1.00B lease draws and +14.68M ATM shares drives our Bear Case to $26.82 (-59.8%) and Expected Value to $59.19 (-11.3%). Price broke our $78.00 equity stop and $80.00 LEAPS floor inside a Stage 4 Downtrend [23][34][35]. We rate new capital REJECTED (TIER_0) and shift our 90.745138 shares to EXIT_IMMEDIATELY.

book_paragraphs: Welcome to the refreshed institutional monograph on DigitalOcean Holdings, Inc., ticker DOCN on the New York Stock Exchange, updated for the November 20, 2026 market close at $66.76. One week ago, DigitalOcean sat at $86.32 with a tentative 4-hour bounce window and a hard daily-close stop at $78.00. On November 20, the stock plunged 13.40% on heavy volume, slicing through both our $80.00 options floor and our $78.00 common-equity stop as the broader S&P 500 deteriorated into a 10-distribution-day Downtrend.

This update combines two independent passes. In Pass 1, our price-blind forensic audit of the Q3 2026 Form 10-Q and November SEC filings uncovered $923.6 million in finance leases, $2.96 billion in off-balance-sheet uncommenced colocation leases, a 28.2% year-to-date jump in basic shares ahead of a new $1.0 billion ATM equity shelf, discontinued Net Dollar Retention disclosures, and a November 19 Form 144 sale notice from CFO Matt Steinfort. In Pass 2, re-underwriting valuation cleanly from true owner earnings shows -$136.0 million to -$986.2 million in annual economic cash burn and a $59.19 probability-weighted expected value.

Accordingly, our New Capital Verdict remains REJECTED at Conviction Tier 0 on TREND, VALUATION, and CASH_FLOW. For the portfolio's existing 90.745138 common shares ($6,058.14 market value) and four June 2027 $150 Call LEAPS ($3,720.00 market value)—a 13.02% combined weight—our holding action escalates from EXIT_ON_BOUNCE to EXIT_IMMEDIATELY, rotating 100% of freed proceeds into Cash.

book_subsections.title: What Changed Between November 13 and November 20, 2026
paragraphs: Three concrete developments transformed our portfolio posture over the past seven days. First, primary-filing forensics proved that DigitalOcean's 40% top-line surge carries far steeper balance-sheet commitments and dilution than headline Adjusted FCF suggests: scheduled finance-lease maturities climb to $250 million annually in 2027–2029, 9M 2026 annualized hardware/lease additions equate to -$986.2 million in economic burn, and Q4 diluted share guidance sits at 128.5 million before tapping a $1.0 billion ATM program.

Second, the equity market repriced the entire neocloud cohort simultaneously, driving DOCN (-13.40%), CoreWeave (-12.02%), and Nebius (-16.11%) deeper into Stage 4 markdowns. Third, breaking $78.00 without a 4-hour turn invalidated our bounce-exit trigger, making immediate capital preservation across Schwab, Robinhood, and the options book non-negotiable.

book_subsections.title: Summary of Quantitative Anchors and Action Plan
paragraphs: At $66.76, DOCN carries a $7.88 billion basic market cap ($8.58 billion diluted), $9.09 billion basic Enterprise Value ($9.79 billion diluted), 8.24x trailing EV/Sales, 33.82x forward P/E, 215.56x trailing P/E, and 1.22% trailing ROIC. Our 12-month scenario range spans $26.82 Bear (35%, 4.0x FY27E sales with +$1.00B lease draws and +14.68M ATM shares), $68.00 Base (45%, 5.5x FY27E sales), and $96.00 Bull (20%, 7.0x FY27E sales), yielding a $59.19 expected value (-11.3%).

We execute EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on all 90.745138 shares (61.3008 at Schwab and 29.444338 at Robinhood), CLOSE all four June 2027 $150 Call LEAPS, and retain 100% of proceeds in Cash/T-Bills while tracking Stage 2 benchmarks Eli Lilly (LLY), AbbVie (ABBV), and Stryker (SYK) at 0% allocation.
